description: 2022 Volvo XC90 T5 Momentum — Bright Silver Metallic exterior with Charcoal leather interior Overview - Powertrain: 2.0L Turbo I4, 250 hp and 258 ft-lb torque (ULEV) - Fuel economy: 20 MPG city / 28 MPG highway - Configurable seating for up to seven with available second-row integrated booster cushion - Asking price: listed below J.D. Power Book value Exterior and appearance This XC90 is finished in Bright Silver Metallic, a neutral, easy-care paint that complements the clean, Scandinavian lines of the XC90. Exterior highlights include Volvo’s signature upright grille and LED lighting elements up front and rear. Roof rails and a set of alloy wheels give the vehicle a practical, family-oriented profile. Interior and comfort The cabin is trimmed in Charcoal leather with matching Charcoal interior accents for a refined, understated look. The Momentum trim focuses on comfort and usability: supportive front seats with power adjustments, a configurable second row that includes the Integrated 2nd Row Center Booster Cushion (useful for children), and flexible third-row seating for occasional use. Materials and finishes emphasize durability and comfort for daily driving and longer trips. Climate Package and climate control This XC90 includes the Climate Package, which enhances passenger comfort for cooler conditions. The vehicle’s ventilation and climate systems are designed to keep the cabin comfortable for all three rows, and the package adds features targeted at improved heating and rapid windshield de-icing/defogging for easier cold-weather operation. Factory-installed features (key items) - Safety and driver assistance: Volvo’s core safety suite (City Safety collision mitigation with pedestrian and cyclist detection), lane keeping aid, driver alert support, and Volvo’s structural safety design. Blind Spot Information System (BLIS) with cross-traffic alert and a rearview camera are included to assist with low-speed maneuvers and lane changes. - Passive safety: Multiple airbags, seatbelt pretensioners and whiplash-reducing head restraints are standard throughout the cabin. - Infotainment and connectivity: Sensus infotainment system with a portrait-style central touchscreen, smartphone integration (Apple CarPlay and Android Auto), Bluetooth hands-free calling and streaming, and multiple USB ports for device charging and connectivity. - Convenience: Keyless entry and push-button start, power liftgate, automatic headlights and wipers, and a clear, driver-focused instrument display and controls. Ample storage areas, cupholders, and practical cargo space with fold-flat rear seats make the XC90 well suited for family duties. - Seating and trim: Durable, easy-to-maintain upholstery surfaces and supportive seating for long drives, the Momentum trim balances comfort and utility without excessive ornamentation. - Wheels and brakes: Alloy wheels paired with four-wheel disc brakes and a stability control system provide predictable handling and stopping performance for everyday driving. Optional/Included items called out - Bright Silver Metallic paint (optional) - Charcoal Leather Seats with Charcoal Interior (optional, specified) - Integrated 2nd Row Center Booster Cushion (optional, specified) - Climate Package (included on this vehicle) Ownership value This example is being offered below the J.D.   • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
  • Brake assist - Stop right there. Something jumps out into the middle of the road and you need to stop now! With brake assist, you will. It uses the speed of the brake pedal's travel to sense panic braking, then applies all available power to boost your stopping power. Brake assist can stop the accident before it is one.
Technology and Telematics

For those long road trips, the **Adaptive cruise control with traffic stop-go** feature is a true game changer. It adapts to changing traffic conditions, bringing the vehicle to a complete stop when necessary and resuming speed as traffic begins to move, reducing the stress of long-distance driving.

Features like **Brake assist** and **Cruise control with steering wheel mounted controls** enhance the overall driving experience, while the **Keyfob vehicle start control** adds convenience by allowing drivers to remotely start their vehicle, ensuring a comfortable cabin temperature before stepping inside.

In conclusion, the 2023 Honda Civic EX is a well-rounded vehicle that prioritizes safety, advanced technology, and an engaging driving experience. Whether you’re commuting or embarking on a road trip, this model is a fantastic choice for anyone seeking reliability and style in their daily drives.
